purpose: Specify a source-neutral feasibility and implementation gate for a later fresh source-reporting study. This artifact is neither an execution protocol nor a data-readiness or precision acceptance.

permitted_now: Write this prospective requirements artifact and its API notes inside the new P05 asset directory.
Read previously allowed planning, source-fact code, catalog and sanitized P02/P04 metadata.
Parse these new artifacts and compute their file hashes.
not_performed_or_authorized_by_this_arti: New original biological-row or candidate-universe scans.
Actual candidate selection, source-file pinning, cohort locking or generation.
Reading candidate outputs, human-response descendants, private reference values or clinical outcomes.
New downloads, model acquisition, model calls, paid provider spending or network work.
Changes to src, the current P04 code inventory, P04 protocol or P04 endpoint.

p04.scope: Two exposed development contexts and one synthetic input-withholding condition; the synthetic condition is not an independent third biological context.
p04.endpoint: The existing P04 reporting endpoint and its source/reference/code seals remain unchanged.
p04.measurement_status: P04 does not study answerable measurement groups.

current_terminal_status.reason: This design does not inspect P04 candidate outputs or assert that the current pilot has reached a terminal closeout.

p02.sanitized_availability_only: The completed credible-set report records a complete 25-file inventory and one developmental exact match with nonnull beta, standardError and pValueMantissa/pValueExponent. sampleSize is native null; units and ancestry are not established; upstream study identity was not independently verified.
p02.interpretation: A source-feasibility observation, not a fresh evaluation cohort, independent replication, scientific validation, causal genetics, MR qualification or clinical outcome.
p02.selected_row_packet_reason: The retained P02 selected-row descendant is evaluator-only. Any later generation packet must be constructed separately from newly admitted original bytes and a neutral plan.

code.current_input_builder: source_fact_inputs.py is an intentionally fixed P04 builder with two development scopes, a fixed EuropePMC inventory, lexical record selection and id/date/cellType requests.
code.existing_generic_support: source_fact_sources.py already supports bounded original fields, exact-key same-release joins and finite native reported_measurement fields; source_fact_evaluation.py provides group-weighted coverage, failure accounting and separate null measurement completion.
code.implementation_consequence: Implement a separately versioned generic source-only builder after P04 terminal closeout. Do not loosen the current P04 builder or claim the proposed interfaces already exist.

catalog.observed_issue: The reviewed catalog still describes credible-set/study products with queued/not_run acquisition blockers. Completed credible-set acquisition metadata must be reconciled before a later scan plan pins actual files.
catalog.not_inferred: Complete credible-set acquisition does not establish study-table acquisition, lawful redistribution, date eligibility, upstream study identity or scientific qualification.

candidate_universe.reason: No new source-neutral candidate inventory has been scanned or selected.

eligible_fresh_candidate_count.reason: Exposure, source admission, measurements and dependence groups have not been established for a new universe.

independent_group_count.reason: No verified study/article/locus/family dependence register exists for new candidates.

answerable_measurement_group_count.reason: No fresh candidate field-availability scan or independent reference derivation has been performed.

actual_source_file_pins.reason: Do not freeze actual source-file pins until P04 has a terminal closeout and source catalog/acquisition metadata have been reconciled.

eligible_original_source_snapshot.reason: A new admitted original-only snapshot has not been compiled.

cutoff_utc.reason: A new contemporary cutoff must follow admitted download/annotation availability; no historical backfill is assumed.

final_arm_schedule.reason: Actual feasible counts, task sizes, controls and resource fit are unknown.

final_resource_budget.reason: The illustrative envelope below is not an execution budget or measured fit.

precision_acceptance.reason: An independent-group count and a prospective inferential target are required before any precision claim.

reference_set.reason: No fresh source-derived references have been built or inspected for this design.

ordered_gates.required_evidence: Retained terminal accounting and immutable closeout for every scheduled current P04 cell, including failures/unexecuted dispositions, before implementing source changes or reconciling metadata for a new scan.
ordered_gates.unknown_reason: No P04 candidate or terminal-output artifact was inspected in this design.

ordered_gates.required_evidence: Reconcile exact existing receipt/index acquisition evidence with catalog collection/parse/validation states without promoting acquisition to scientific validation. Record unresolved source families separately.
ordered_gates.unknown_reason: This artifact does not modify the catalog or acquire sources.

ordered_gates.required_evidence: Implement the proposed source-only declarative builder and admission/register interfaces with meaningful synthetic negative controls, independent original-to-fact checks and exact legacy P04 regressions. Version all changed contracts.
ordered_gates.unknown_reason: Only design and API notes are authorized now; the live P04 protocol pins the complete src inventory.

ordered_gates.required_evidence: Approve a neutral scan plan after G0-G2; declare its complete existing inventory, projections, budgets, exposure policy and exclusions before reading candidate values. Retain counts and every terminal scan disposition.
ordered_gates.unknown_reason: No new original-row scan is performed or authorized by this design.

ordered_gates.required_evidence: Use actual admitted fresh measurement tasks and conservative dependence groups to select the reporting claim, precision objective, all-cell schedule, controls, resources and fallback. Check exact-projection ceiling before locking on exposed development only.
ordered_gates.unknown_reason: The actual fresh universe, study mappings and local task-size/resource fit are unknown.

ordered_gates.required_evidence: Create a separate immutable execution protocol only after prior gates pass; include actual source/reference/code/runtime pins, complete schedule, all exclusions, primary contrast, intervals, budgets and no-retry rules before any new candidate generation.
ordered_gates.unknown_reason: This design is explicitly not a lock and contains no eligible-cohort assertion.

declarative_source_spec.scope_frame_rule: Specify the entire finite metadata-defined frame independently of observed candidate/model success; do not embed selected biological IDs in this design.

record_selector.requirements: Same rule for every eligible member of the declared frame; fully enumerate matches within the declared inventory before applying a prespecified count cap. Conflicting duplicate identities block or retain an explicit conflict, without favorable substitution.

declarative_source_spec.field_requests: Literal original top-level fields, existing known family labels, deterministic group rules, original unit_field or null, and explicit empty policy. No derived direction, effect conversion, numeric coercion or invented context.
declarative_source_spec.join_specs: Explicit left/right keys, native exact type/value matching, same-release requirement in the current reference contract, cardinality and bounded inventory completeness. Retain zero, one, multiple and conflicting matches with all selected locators.

metadata_reconciliation.boundary: Metadata-only; never infer row content, scientific readiness or source eligibility from a completion count alone. Actual source pins are a later artifact after reconciliation.

feasibility_scan_plan.boundary: Requires G0-G2. Plans inventory/projections and constraints; does not select actual candidates or assert measurements.

feasibility_scan.boundary: Not implemented or runnable by this artifact. No model calls, reference grading, output-aware selection or biological outcomes. Keep any value-bearing intermediate restricted and outside generation/reference contexts.

source_only_generation.boundary: Read originals independently; every source, mapping and neutral-plan ancestor must be admitted. Packets may contain requested original source values but never expected reference answers. The selector and task slots must have clean prospective provenance.

independent_reference.boundary: Reconstruct locators, joins and expected literal facts directly from admitted originals under the same neutral rule; do not derive expected facts from the generation packet. Reuse compile_reference/verify_reference only with independently checked selection/derivation and externally supplied approved roots. Seal references before new generation; never feed them to generation or stage control.

scoring_and_analysis.boundary: The common adapter reads emitted bytes only and does not repair/insert values. Preserve unreadable and unsuccessful cells in the planned-cell denominator. No inherited acceptance is claimed for this proposed API.

register_schema.unknown_value_contract: An unavailable field is represented by value:null plus a nonblank reason; unknown is never zero, a negative biological result or an independent-group assertion.

candidate_row.scope: Target/indication IDs and namespace versions with nullable action/modality/tissue and explicit reasons; preserve source context without inferring intervention biology.
candidate_row.source_bindings: Dataset/source/release ID, logical path, bytes/hash/receipt hash/schema hash and physical locator. Bind actual values only in a later restricted instantiated register.
candidate_row.requested_field_families: identity_linkage, reported_context, reported_measurement and provider_metric are separate. Provider scores are never effect measurements.
candidate_row.field_availability: Per requested literal field: schema presence, native type class, null/empty/nonempty status, finite-number QC, original unit-field availability and unknown reason. Sanitized exports contain counts/status, not reference values.
candidate_row.join_status: Declared key/cardinality/inventory scope, counts of zero/one/multiple/conflicting exact matches, duplicate physical occurrences and unresolved reasons. Completeness is bounded to the declared inventory.
candidate_row.gate_statuses: Separate rights, date, admission, publication, exposure, study_identity and source_role assessments. Each has pass/fail/unknown/not_applicable, evidence metadata and a reason; no omnibus ready Boolean substitutes for them.
candidate_row.group_assignment: All available study/cohort/article/locus/target-family nodes and conservative connected dependence-group ID, with verification status and unknown reasons.
candidate_row.decision_provenance: Metadata rule/version and timestamp; no candidate outcome, reference score or post-generation repair criterion. Preserve every considered candidate and exclusion.

exposure_event.content_extent: Distinguish filenames/counts from original row content, reference answers and generated output. Metadata-only access is not silently equated to answer exposure.
exposure_event.propagation: Apply the later declared policy through duplicate records, studies/cohorts/articles/loci/related hypotheses and response-derived descendants. Known development/tuning items and used controls cannot become fresh locked cases. Sealed reference preparation is permitted only under enforced generation isolation.
exposure_event.freshness_claim: Project exposure under this declared policy only; public-source absence from model training is unknown.

dependence_node.verification: Retain native studyId separately from verified upstream study/cohort identity. Unverified native IDs do not establish independent studies. Article equivalences need deterministic metadata evidence; locus/family rules must be declared without inferred causal interpretation.

dependence_edge.grouping_rule: Conservative connected components of declared dependence edges; allocate entire components to development or evaluation. Keep multiway identifiers for sensitivity analyses. Shared release or Parquet file alone is not biological dependence.
dependence_edge.unresolved_policy: Do not count unresolved study/article/locus/family relationships as proven independence. Exclude from inferential groups or retain under a declared conservative coalescing sensitivity; report exploratory case-level results separately.

scan_disposition.rule: Every planned inventory unit has one terminal disposition; partial enumeration cannot be relabeled complete or treated as an exhaustive zero.

neutral_full_inventory_feasibility_plan.inventory_basis: Only existing acquired originals in later reconciled source-family inventories, selected by neutral metadata requirements; no new download or response-derived packet.

actual_filenames_hashes_and_counts.reason: Freeze these in a separate scan artifact only after current P04 terminal closeout and catalog reconciliation.

candidate_scope_ids.reason: No candidate selection or biological source-value scan is performed by this design.

steps: Declare the source-family/frame rule, exact schemas/columns, exposure policy, dependence policy and finite byte/file/row/time/memory caps before reading original candidate values.
Authenticate the whole declared inventory, receipt bindings, roles, deny ancestry, availability and schemas before any candidate value projection; retain separate gate failures.
Enumerate key columns across every planned eligible file and row group, with a stable physical locator. Do not stop at a promising shard or first useful candidate.
Project requested literal measurements/context for all exact matches admitted by the declared key rule; enumerate every match before any prespecified stable count cap.
Preserve duplicates, conflicting values and unresolved joins; zero within a complete declared inventory remains collection-bounded and never biological absence.
Construct sanitized availability and full candidate/exclusion/exposure/dependence registers. Keep original values in their restricted source context, not this design or general planning prose.
Measure preparation, hashing, projected logical bytes, peak-memory counters and time. Leave physical I/O and unobserved platform/reference costs null with reasons.
Reconcile every planned scan unit to a terminal disposition; if inventory/budget completion fails, stop the completeness claim without favorable replacement scans.

resource_caps.reason: A later metadata-sized plan must set actual caps; P04 preparation bounds do not establish fit for new measurement joins.

neutral_full_inventory_feasibility_plan.output_boundary: Feasibility counts and gates precede candidate generation. Any actually examined development content is exposure-tagged; no observed successful candidate is silently promoted to fresh evaluation.

proposed_reporting_task_and_endpoint.task: Compose eligible original records under an exact target/indication anchor and declared same-release study/locus joins, then report requested native measurements, context and explicit collection-bounded unknowns with original bindings.
proposed_reporting_task_and_endpoint.nontrivial_scope_gate: A later measurement task must demonstrate actual exact-key multi-record composition and answerable measurement groups beyond identifiers/dates. Predeclare minimum measurement-content requirements on exposed development before the fresh scan/lock; do not choose them using new candidate output performance.

minimum_content_rule.reason: Whether effect, uncertainty and significance groups can all be supported across fresh sources is unknown. A development contract decision is required before fresh selection.

proposed_reporting_task_and_endpoint.provider_metric_policy: Descriptive only; no primary measurement credit, effect-size substitution or scientific importance inference.

measurement_group_policy.group_identity: One record and one family per group, as required by the current compiler; preserve every requested field and source binding.

proposed_groups.rule: Use the applicable original field only; do not convert scales or infer direction on a gene/drug.
Group a requested interval's lower/upper components together; no computed interval substitutes for missing originals.
Use a frozen native representation; group mantissa/exponent together rather than creating two independent outcomes. Do not reconstruct or round a p-value.

measurement_group_policy.weights: Average matched-slot fractions equally across answerable predeclared measurement groups. Unknown-only groups have no coverage denominator. Preserve group/slot/family counts and full coverage distributions.
measurement_group_policy.critical_error_policy: Retain the current common mechanical policy for wrong native values/types, units, sources, unknown reasons, duplicate/conflicting emissions and invented facts. Correct facts do not offset errors.
measurement_group_policy.completion_rule_proposal: Valid answered/partial output, correct collection disposition, zero mechanical critical errors and at least 80% answerable measurement-group coverage. Freeze 60/80/100% sensitivity reporting before generation.
measurement_group_policy.zero_measurement_groups: Measurement coverage and completion remain null; no identifier, date, provider score or correct unknown can rescue a measurement endpoint.
measurement_group_policy.unknown_only_task: Score bounded insufficient-input handling separately; 0/0 never passes coverage.
measurement_group_policy.independence: Facts, groups, repeated passages, records, conditions, judges and arms are not independent biological cases.

exact_unknowns.unit_policy: unit is the literal original unit_field value or null. The current wire has no unit-specific unknown-reason field; distinguish absent/unrequested/null/unverified units in source/register metadata with value:null plus a reason. Do not invent unit reasons or new wire fields without a separately versioned, tested contract.
exact_unknowns.sample_size_and_ancestry: Request only supported literal original context fields. Preserve native schema absence/null/empty distinctions; do not borrow context from unrelated records or infer it from locus/study IDs.
exact_unknowns.native_measurement_qc: Finite native integers/floats excluding Boolean; pValueExponent is an integer. Incompatible types fail QC rather than being coerced. Preserve native typed values and signed zero.
exact_unknowns.study_identity: Unknown verified upstream study identity is a dependence/admission metadata blocker, not a fabricated unknown measurement or proof of independence.
exact_unknowns.semantic_limit: Native source reporting does not establish unit validity, causal target relevance, biological direction, clinical efficacy, scientific truth, MR validity or therapeutic usefulness.

proposed_reporting_task_and_endpoint.ceiling_check: On exposed development only, run exact literal projection under the same admitted sources/slots/common bounds. If it reaches the reporting ceiling, frame later work as verification/completion/resource tradeoffs; do not claim biomedical reasoning gains or alter locked tasks after seeing arm outcomes.

separate_gate_blockers.question: Are exact artifact access, use, attribution and redistribution dispositions established?
separate_gate_blockers.reason: Provider visibility/code licensing do not establish every source asset's rights; no new rights review is performed here.

separate_gate_blockers.question: Do source/annotation/public availability and receipt instants qualify under the exact new cutoff?
separate_gate_blockers.reason: No new cutoff or source snapshot is frozen; complete acquisition alone is insufficient.

separate_gate_blockers.question: Do whole-ancestry hashes, receipts, trusted roots, deny lists, schemas and scope pass?
separate_gate_blockers.reason: No new source inventory has undergone admission under a P05 contract.

separate_gate_blockers.question: Are original publication identity/date and reported evidence provenance established separately from data-release dates?
separate_gate_blockers.reason: Native study identifiers and file receipt dates do not verify an upstream article or publication context.

separate_gate_blockers.question: Is each candidate and related group eligible under the prospective project-exposure policy?
separate_gate_blockers.reason: The new candidate universe and exposure register are not instantiated; existing development units stay exposed.

separate_gate_blockers.question: Can upstream studies/cohorts/articles/loci/families be verified well enough for the declared grouping and precision claim?
separate_gate_blockers.reason: The developmental credible-set native studyId was retained without verified upstream study metadata; no new independent-group count is available.

separate_gate_blockers.question: Are original source/mapping ancestors lawfully admitted to agent_evidence/reference roles and all evaluator/response descendants excluded?
separate_gate_blockers.reason: Catalog roles are necessary but do not promote evaluator-only descendants or substitute for a new ancestry check.

analysis_and_precision_requirements.primary_contrast_proposal: AsOf reporting adaptation versus plain evidence-grounded reporting using the same one existing pinned local model and common source view.

primary_estimand.reason: Decide between a finite selected-frame descriptive estimand and a defensible independent-group generalization target after actual source feasibility; convenience selection does not imply population representativeness.

analysis_and_precision_requirements.proposed_unit: At most one primary task per conservative independent dependence component where practical; otherwise predeclare component aggregation/weighting. Conditions and repeated records remain paired within that component.
analysis_and_precision_requirements.reporting: Report all paired outcomes, discordances, case/group counts, coverage distribution, mechanical critical errors, abstention, missing-input handling and terminal failures. Distinguish actual from synthetic conditions.

desired_half_width.reason: A precision objective must be chosen prospectively with the intended claim and actual feasible independent-group count.

interval_method.reason: Predeclare and implement the exact paired/group-aware method before lock. Do not use a slot-level binomial interval or a small-cluster bootstrap as automatic precision acceptance.

analysis_and_precision_requirements.conservative_planning_example: For independent group-level paired differences bounded in [-1,1], Hoeffding gives a two-sided 95% half-width sqrt(2*ln(40)/N); half-width <=0.20 requires N>=185. This illustrative distribution-free calculation is not a sample-size promise, assumes independent admitted groups and does not establish representativeness.
analysis_and_precision_requirements.small_group_policy: If fresh coverage, verified independence or attainable precision is inadequate, freeze exploratory source-reporting/technical feasibility scope before generation and report selection limitations. Do not multiply slots, variants, synthetic conditions or judges into a larger N.
sensitivity_requirements: Every planned terminal cell retained; no successful-output-only completion denominator.

illustrative_resource_envelope_only.generation_calls_formula: 12 * (1 plain + at most 2 AsOf) + 3 * (1 plain + 0 AsOf missing-input preflight); deterministic arms make no model calls.
illustrative_resource_envelope_only.assumptions: Same one existing acquired local model/runtime; source-only packets; AsOf second stage only under a prospectively declared structural gate, never reference-score feedback. This equation is not evidence that 12 fresh groups exist or that task sizes fit.
illustrative_resource_envelope_only.controls_and_ablations: Additional synthetic fault/valid-control/ablation cells are not included in 60/39. A later protocol must enumerate their full conditions, calls, matched valid controls, independent-case status and aggregate limits before execution.

resource_limits.reason: Per-cell/aggregate time, token, byte and memory caps require new task-size and measured access preflight; current P04 caps are historical design inputs only.

fixed_constraints: One already acquired local model; no new downloads or stronger-model assumption.
Provider spending stays $0; that is not total cost.
Sequential owned local server and bounded launch/termination if a later qualified runner is used.
No response-dependent retry, repair, case substitution or unreported expansion.
Count source preparation failures, independent reference construction, hashing/indexing/setup, every stage and scoring overhead separately.
Keep unmeasured physical I/O, native peak-memory and platform/reference costs null with reasons.

required: Parse the new design as strict JSON.
Check DESIGN_NOT_LOCKED and absence of a concrete cohort/source pin/schedule.
Check the illustrative 60-cell/39-call arithmetic without asserting feasibility.
Compute SHA-256 and byte sizes of the two new P05 assets.
verification_for_this_design.not_claimed: No application tests, data replay, source scans, model runs, P04 acceptance changes, cohort qualification or prospective lock.
